items.name: Patchward
items.shorthand: Mended.
items.description: Restore Vitality equal to your Spirit.

items.name: Sanctify
items.shorthand: Restored (Two Targets).
items.description: Two Targets: everything applies to all targets. The target gains 1 Charge.

items.name: Darkshroud
items.shorthand: Obscured (Three Targets).
items.description: Three Targets: everything applies to all targets. Enemies cannot see or target the target until it deals damage or is dealt damage.

items.name: Wardseal
items.shorthand: Guarded (Three Targets).
items.description: Three Targets: everything applies to all targets. Reduce the next damage the target takes before your next roll by your Power.

items.name: Doomward
items.shorthand: Purged (All Targets).
items.description: All Targets: everything applies to all targets. Remove one Affliction from the target.

items.name: Mirrorbind
items.shorthand: Warded (All Targets).
items.description: All Targets: everything applies to all targets. Reduce the next Magic damage the target takes before your next roll by your Magic.

items.name: Dent
items.shorthand: Attack. On a hit, deal Standard Damage, then Exposed.
items.description: On a hit, the target suffers Standard Damage. Ignore the target's Durability.

items.name: Fracture
items.shorthand: Attack. On a hit, deal Standard Damage, then Diminished.
items.description: On a hit, the target suffers Standard Damage. Apply the Diminished affliction.

items.name: Dreadcleave
items.shorthand: Attack. On a hit, deal Double Base Damage, then Cleaved.
items.description: On a hit, the target suffers Double Base Damage. Then deal your Base Damage to another target.

items.name: Breach
items.shorthand: Attack. On a hit, deal Standard Damage, then Unclad.
items.description: On a hit, the target suffers Standard Damage. Apply the Unclad affliction.

items.name: Shatter
items.shorthand: Sabotaged. On a hit, deal Double Base Damage.
items.description: Ignore the target's Armor Stance. On a hit, the target suffers Double Base Damage.

items.name: Ruinburst
items.shorthand: Attack (Two Targets). On a hit, deal Standard Damage, then Crippled.
items.description: Two Targets: everything applies to all targets. On a hit, all targets suffer Standard Damage. Apply the Crippled affliction.

items.name: Pilfer
items.shorthand: Attack. On a hit, deal Standard Damage, then Transferred.
items.description: On a hit, the target suffers Standard Damage. Take 1 Charge from the target.

items.name: Nullbite
items.shorthand: Attack. On a hit, deal Standard Damage, then Disenchanted.
items.description: On a hit, the target suffers Standard Damage. Apply the Disenchanted affliction.

items.name: Quash
items.shorthand: Attack. On a hit, deal Double Standard Damage, then Drained.
items.description: On a hit, the target suffers Double Standard Damage. The target loses 1 Charge.

items.name: Foilpoint
items.shorthand: Attack. On a hit, deal Standard Damage, then Disarmed.
items.description: On a hit, the target suffers Standard Damage. Apply the Disarmed affliction.

items.name: Turnblade
items.shorthand: Attack. On a hit, deal Double Standard Damage, then Siphoned.
items.description: On a hit, the target suffers Double Standard Damage. Then deal Base Damage and restore that much Vitality.

items.name: Severance
items.shorthand: Attack (Two Targets). On a hit, deal Standard Damage, then Lacerated.
items.description: Two Targets: everything applies to all targets. On a hit, all targets suffer Standard Damage. Apply the Lacerated affliction.

items.name: Batter
items.shorthand: Attack. On a hit, deal Standard Damage, then Crushed.
items.description: On a hit, the target suffers Standard Damage. Deal your Base Damage again.

items.name: Crack
items.shorthand: Attack (Two Targets). On a hit, deal Standard Damage, then Bruised.
items.description: Two Targets: everything applies to all targets. On a hit, all targets suffer Standard Damage. Apply the Bruised affliction.

items.name: Maul
items.shorthand: Attack. On a hit, deal Double Standard Damage, then Bonus Damage.
items.description: On a hit, the target suffers Double Standard Damage. Add 1d6 to your Bonus Damage.

items.name: Mangulate
items.shorthand: Attack (Two Targets). On a hit, deal Standard Damage, then Dazzled.
items.description: Two Targets: everything applies to all targets. On a hit, all targets suffer Standard Damage. Apply the Dazzled affliction.

items.name: Disjointer
items.shorthand: Attack. On a hit, deal Double Base Damage, then Staggered.
items.description: On a hit, the target suffers Double Base Damage. Apply the Staggered affliction.

items.name: Maelstrom
items.shorthand: Attack (Three Targets). On a hit, deal Standard Damage, then Scattered.
items.description: Three Targets: everything applies to all targets. On a hit, all targets suffer Standard Damage. Move each affected target 3 spaces from a chosen space.

items.name: Ricochet
items.shorthand: Attack. On a hit, deal Standard Damage, then Refracted.
items.description: On a hit, the target suffers Standard Damage. Another target takes half your Bonus Damage.

items.name: Killmark
items.shorthand: Attack. On a hit, deal Standard Damage, then Hunted.
items.description: On a hit, the target suffers Standard Damage. Apply the Hunted affliction.

items.name: Skydrive
items.shorthand: Attack. On a hit, deal Double Standard Damage, then Pushed.
items.description: On a hit, the target suffers Double Standard Damage. Move the target 3 spaces directly away.

items.name: Weakpoint
items.shorthand: Attack (Two Targets). On a hit, deal Standard Damage, then Vulnerable.
items.description: Two Targets: everything applies to all targets. On a hit, all targets suffer Standard Damage. Apply the Vulnerable affliction.

items.name: Fellshot
items.shorthand: Tracked (Two Targets). On a hit, deal Double Standard Damage.
items.description: Two Targets: everything applies to all targets. Ignore your weapon's range. On a hit, all targets suffer Double Standard Damage.

items.name: Anchorpoint
items.shorthand: Attack (Three Targets). On a hit, deal Standard Damage, then Impeded.
items.description: Three Targets: everything applies to all targets. On a hit, all targets suffer Standard Damage. Apply the Impeded affliction.

items.name: Razorwind
items.shorthand: Cast. On a success, deal Standard Damage, then Pierced.
items.description: On a success, the target suffers Standard Damage. Ignore the target's Resistance.

items.name: Pyre
items.shorthand: Cast (Two Targets). On a success, deal Standard Damage, then Ignited.
items.description: Two Targets: everything applies to all targets. On a success, all targets suffer Standard Damage. Apply the Ignited affliction.

items.name: Worldspire
items.shorthand: Cast. On a success, deal Double Standard Damage, then Manifested.
items.description: On a success, the target suffers Double Standard Damage. Create a temporary object, barrier, or terrain feature in an empty space that has a Vitality of 1.

items.name: Chainlight
items.shorthand: Cast (Three Targets). On a success, deal Standard Damage, then Echoed.
items.description: Three Targets: everything applies to all targets. On a success, all targets suffer Standard Damage. The next spell the target casts also targets themselves.

items.name: Hoarfrost
items.shorthand: Cast. On a success, deal Standard Damage, then Frozen.
items.description: On a success, the target suffers Standard Damage. Apply the Frozen affliction.

items.name: Faultline
items.shorthand: Ensnared (Two Targets). On a success, the target is afflicted.
items.description: Two Targets: everything applies to all targets. On a success, apply the Ensnared affliction.

items.name: Overtake
items.shorthand: Attack. On a hit, deal Standard Damage, then Pulled.
items.description: On a hit, the target suffers Standard Damage. Move the target 3 spaces directly toward you.

items.name: Sideline
items.shorthand: Attack (Two Targets). On a hit, deal Standard Damage, then Immobilized.
items.description: Two Targets: everything applies to all targets. On a hit, all targets suffer Standard Damage. Apply the Immobilized affliction.

items.name: Pathmaker
items.shorthand: Attack. On a hit, deal Double Standard Damage, then Placed.
items.description: On a hit, the target suffers Double Standard Damage. Move the target to an empty space within 3 spaces.

items.name: Redline
items.shorthand: Attack. On a hit, deal Standard Damage, then Frenzied.
items.description: On a hit, the target suffers Standard Damage. Apply the Frenzied affliction.

items.name: Convergence
items.shorthand: Attack (Three Targets). On a hit, deal Standard Damage, then Gathered.
items.description: Three Targets: everything applies to all targets. On a hit, all targets suffer Standard Damage. Move each affected target 3 spaces toward a chosen space.

items.name: Crosscut
items.shorthand: Attack (Two Targets). On a hit, deal Standard Damage, then Slashed.
items.description: Two Targets: everything applies to all targets. On a hit, all targets suffer Standard Damage. Apply the Slashed affliction.

items.name: Overrun
items.shorthand: Attack (Two Targets). On a hit, deal Standard Damage, then Pursued.
items.description: Two Targets: everything applies to all targets. On a hit, all targets suffer Standard Damage. Move adjacent to the target.

items.name: Rattle
items.shorthand: Attack (Two Targets). On a hit, deal Standard Damage, then Disoriented.
items.description: Two Targets: everything applies to all targets. On a hit, all targets suffer Standard Damage. Apply the Disoriented affliction.

items.name: Battlewake
items.shorthand: Attack (Two Targets). On a hit, deal Double Standard Damage, then Advanced.
items.description: Two Targets: everything applies to all targets. On a hit, all targets suffer Double Standard Damage. Move up to 3 spaces.

items.name: Fray
items.shorthand: Attack. On a hit, deal Standard Damage, then Vitiated.
items.description: On a hit, the target suffers Standard Damage. Apply the Vitiated affliction.

items.name: Shuffle
items.shorthand: Attack. On a hit, deal Double Standard Damage, then Swapped.
items.description: On a hit, the target suffers Double Standard Damage. Swap positions with the target.

items.name: Onslaught
items.shorthand: Attack (Two Targets). On a hit, deal Standard Damage, then Agonized.
items.description: Two Targets: everything applies to all targets. On a hit, all targets suffer Standard Damage. Apply the Agonized affliction.

items.name: Shardsling
items.shorthand: Redirected.
items.description: Move one Effect from one target to another.

items.name: Ashwake
items.shorthand: Cast (Two Targets). On a success, deal Standard Damage, then Jinxed.
items.description: Two Targets: everything applies to all targets. On a success, all targets suffer Standard Damage. Apply the Jinxed affliction.

items.name: Witherwell
items.shorthand: Accursed (Two Targets). On a success, the target is afflicted.
items.description: Two Targets: everything applies to all targets. On a success, apply the Accursed affliction.

items.name: Smother
items.shorthand: Cast. On a success, deal Standard Damage, then Unlucky.
items.description: On a success, the target suffers Standard Damage. Apply the Unlucky affliction.

items.name: Cataclysm
items.shorthand: Plagued. On a success, the target is afflicted.
items.description: On a success, apply the Plagued affliction.

items.name: Synchronize
items.shorthand: Conjoined (Two Targets). On a success, the target is afflicted.
items.description: Two Targets: everything applies to all targets. On a success, apply the Conjoined affliction.
